channel.title: Arista Networks, Inc. — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Arista Networks, Inc. (arista).

item.title: CVE-2026-121371 · 8.7 HIGH — Security Advisory 0218
item.description: On affected EOS versions with the eAPI service enabled, a specially crafted HTTP request can allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read arbitrary files, including sensitive credentials from the switch filesystem.
